/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' game/README.md && printf '\\n--- LANTERNS FILES ---\\n' && rg --files game/games/lanterns | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,260p' game/games/lanterns/README.md && printf '\\n--- LOGIC ---\\n' && sed -n '1,360p' game/games/lanterns/logic/src/lib.rs && printf '\\n--- CARGO ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' game/games/lanterns/logic/Cargo.toml"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '260,760p' game/games/lanterns/logic/src/lib.rs && printf '\\n--- TEST SOURCES ---\\n' && for f in game/games/lanterns/logic/src/kind_tests.rs game/games/lanterns/logic/src/scene_tests.rs game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/timing.rs game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/difficult_moment.rs game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/capture.rs; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,360p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"phase|won|all lantern|return|count|remaining|instruction|status|victory|win|lantern\" game/games/lanterns/{app.contract,app.json,proof.mjs,assets/lanterns-adapter.mjs,logic/src,logic/tests} --glob '"'!*.glb'"' && printf '\\n--- APP CONTRACT ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' game/games/lanterns/app.contract && printf '\\n--- PROOF ---\\n' && sed -n '1,420p' game/games/lanterns/proof.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' game/games/lanterns/assets/lanterns-adapter.mjs && rg -n \"shape .*|: boolean|when hud\\..*\" game/games -g 'app.contract' | head -120 && sed -n '1,220p' game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/timing.rs"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- game/games/lanterns/logic/src/lib.rs game/games/lanterns/app.contract game/games/lanterns/assets/lanterns-adapter.mjs game/games/lanterns/README.md game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/capture.rs'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt --manifest-path game/Cargo.toml -p lanterns-logic -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path game/Cargo.toml -p lanterns-logic'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt --manifest-path game/Cargo.toml -p lanterns-logic && cargo test --manifest-path game/Cargo.toml -p lanterns-logic'

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && wc -l game/games/lanterns/logic/src/lib.rs game/games/lanterns/logic/tests/capture.rs game/games/lanterns/app.contract game/games/lanterns/assets/lanterns-adapter.mjs && git diff --name-only'
